WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'MISSING') as state,
    COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count
  FROM Accounts a
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'MISSING')
),
total_and_num_states AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(account_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_states
  FROM state_counts
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.account_count,
    sc.account_count / t.total_count as share,
    1.0 / t.num_states as avg_share
  FROM state_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_and_num_states t
)
SELECT 
  SUM(account_count) as combined_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM state_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
